# saige: Super Artificial Intelligence Graph Environment

> A Go SDK and CLI for building AI agents, giving them context and memory, and evaluating them.

Combines three packages: agent (streaming AI agent loop with typed deltas, tool dispatch, sub-agents, human-in-the-loop markers, structured output, resilience via retry/fallback across adapters for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and the local Ollama runtime, conversation tree with branching and compaction, and RLHF feedback), knowledge (LLM-powered knowledge graph construction with PostgreSQL + pgvector and hybrid search), and rag (multi-modal RAG pipelines with chunking, multi-retriever fusion, reranking, HyDE query transformation, and citations). Includes research tools (web search via SearXNG, file search/read, knowledge graph CRUD), opt-in tool packs (workspace files with root confinement, a sandboxed bash tool with command/env/network policy, and a URL fetch tool that blocks private and metadata addresses; mutating tools always require approval) and an MCP server binary (`saige-mcp`) that exposes tool packs over stdio for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and other MCP clients. Includes a universal evaluation framework with built-in scorers for text quality, agent performance, RAG relevance, and knowledge graph extraction. Ships a CLI (`saige`) with interactive chat, single-shot queries, an HTTP + SSE server (`saige serve`) with approve and cancel endpoints, and standalone RAG/KG operations.

- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): Index of every guide

- [agent/README.md](agent/README.md): Agent framework: adapters, deltas, tools, sub-agents, markers, conversation tree, RLHF feedback, TUI, testing
- [rag/knowledge/README.md](rag/knowledge/README.md): Knowledge graph SDK: graph interface, hybrid search, deduplication, PostgreSQL backend
- [rag/README.md](rag/README.md): RAG pipelines: data model, chunking, retrieval, reranking, HyDE, metrics, tool bindings
- [eval/README.md](eval/README.md): Evaluation framework: scorers, A/B experiments, LLM-as-judge, stream timing
- [cmd/saige/README.md](cmd/saige/README.md): CLI reference: chat, ask, serve, rag, kg
- [cmd/saige-mcp/README.md](cmd/saige-mcp/README.md): MCP server setup for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI
- [docs/catalog.md](docs/catalog.md): Model catalog and presets: JSON schema, sources and layers, merge rules, precedence, validation, preset building, CLI
- [docs/dials.md](docs/dials.md): Model-neutral dials: creativity, reasoning depth, max output, tools, seed and cache compiled per model, policy, precedence, reports, scenarios
- [docs/tool-calling.md](docs/tool-calling.md): Tool calling: lifecycle, client vs server tools, parallel vs sequential execution, model-side vs saige-side parallelism, tool choice and vendor limits, where each knob lives
- [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md): Handoffs vs subagents (delegate, spawn): context in, data out, transcripts, size limits, iteration limits
- [docs/func-tools.md](docs/func-tools.md): Typed function tools: agent.Func, RunContext, schema-hash versions, agent.AIFunc
- [docs/approval-policy.md](docs/approval-policy.md): Approval policy: grants by scope and expiry, denial limits, capability defaults, replay
- [docs/memory.md](docs/memory.md): Memory: host scope, approval-gated writes, recall modes, Postgres hybrid recall, conversation recall, retention, post-run extraction
- [docs/mcp-client.md](docs/mcp-client.md): MCP client: pooled sessions, retries, drift detection, config loading
- [docs/durable-execution.md](docs/durable-execution.md): Durable runs: local engine and duraturo engine on Postgres, approvals, uncertain steps, reconciliation, budget receipts
- [docs/observability.md](docs/observability.md): OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics: span tree, usage, routing, error kinds, redaction
- [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md): Single PostgreSQL 18 deployment with pgvector and pg_search, migrations, hybrid search
- [docs/model-capabilities.md](docs/model-capabilities.md): Capability declarations per vendor and the gaps still open
- [docs/orchestration-policies.md](docs/orchestration-policies.md): Conversation ownership, subagent results, handoff return links, sticky routing, approval limits
- [docs/cache-contracts.md](docs/cache-contracts.md): Cache identity, provider cache modes, known limits
- [docs/tool-schemas.md](docs/tool-schemas.md): Nullable tool properties across vendor APIs and MCP
- [docs/tree-traces.md](docs/tree-traces.md): Printing a conversation tree as JSON
- [docs/upgrade-notes.md](docs/upgrade-notes.md): Behavior changes that can affect existing code
- [docs/system-hardening.md](docs/system-hardening.md): What the hardening release changed and how each fix was verified
- [tools/research/README.md](tools/research/README.md): Research tools: web search, file ops, knowledge graph CRUD
- [tools/fs/README.md](tools/fs/README.md): Workspace file tools: read with paging, glob, grep, write, edit; read-only by default
- [tools/exec/README.md](tools/exec/README.md): Sandboxed bash tool: Sandbox interface, subprocess backend, command/env/network policy
